profile.summary: indigolain is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, demonstrated through targeted contributions to its core functionality. Their work spans bug fixes, animation rendering improvements, scale/legend logic enhancements, and documentation refinement. The developer shows strong debugging skills, particularly in handling edge cases like race conditions and null/undefined values, as well as practical TypeScript awareness in documentation contexts. Contributions are focused on maintaining both current and legacy versions of Chart.js, indicating proficiency in version-specific development. While contributions are limited to a single library, the depth of technical engagement suggests a strong ability to understand complex JavaScript ecosystems.
